newsitem.title: USA: Canyon Resources mine produced gold.
newsitem.headline: Canyon Resources mine produced gold.

text.p: Canyon Resources Corp said its Briggs Mine produced 3,849 ounces of gold in January.
The company said it expects the mine to reach its 6,000-6,500 ounces-per-month design target by March or April, achieving an average annual production rate of 75,000 ounces.
Canyon Resources also said it has commenced drilling additional gold reserves adjacent to the mine in the Panamint Valley of southeastern California.

The Briggs gold mine was constructed and commenced operations in 1996. The initial phase of pad construction was completed in November, with the final placement of pad overliner. By January, 920,000 tons of crushed ore, containing 35,200 ounces of gold, had been placed on the leach pad.
The mine's current hedge position consists of 245,000 ounces of gold sold forward and gold loans that will be delivered at prices averaging $402 per ounce, Canyon said.
